description: Synthetic CPF test fixtures for cpf-validator-js. All numbers are generated test data, produced with the standard CPF check-digit algorithm - they are not real people's CPFs. 'validFormatted' and 'validUnformatted' pass both check digits. 'validLeadingZero' are valid CPFs that begin with 0 and break if the value is handled as a number instead of a string. 'invalidCheckDigit' fail the first or the second check digit. 'invalidRepeatedDigits' satisfy the check-digit math but must be rejected, because repeated-digit sequences are never valid CPFs.
